subject.title: feat: add Baseten Model API provider

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor Baseten as an official external provider after the runtime and changelog blockers are fixed?
rationale: The patch adds a maintained official package, public onboarding and credential surfaces, a default model, and a curated vendor catalog; code correctness alone cannot establish that ongoing support commitment.

options.title: Sponsor after fixes
options.body: Accept Baseten as an official external provider once both stream paths are correct, proof covers simple completions, and release-owned changelog content is removed.

options.title: Keep community-owned
options.body: Do not add it to OpenClaw's official catalog and instead publish the provider independently through ClawHub/npm with community ownership.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after fixes
recommendation.body: Accept Baseten as an official external provider once both stream paths are correct, proof covers simple completions, and release-owned changelog content is removed.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the feature sponsor, canonical issue author, trusted repository actor, and implementation owner shown by the available history.
